{{Quote|They had fought separately, on the Ash Plains of Lenico and in the asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant.|Jedi Master Ngani Zho, on his apprentices|<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lenico IV]] in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]]. The engagement, which took place on Lenico's barren and inhospitable [[Ash Plains]], was participated in by at least one of the [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]]&mdash;[[Satele Shan]], [[Syo Bakarn]], [[Jaric Kaedan]], and [[Bela Kiwiiks]].<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on the Ash Plains of Lenico IV was first mentioned in [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Lost Suns, Part 1'']]&mdash;the seventh entry in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The comic, released in [[2011]], was penned by [[Alexander Freed]].
